title: Blade printing of low-melting-point alloys as back electrodes for high-efficiency and stable inverted perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4142-4152
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00269A, Paper
Bo Jiang, Boyang Yu, Yong Zhang, Weiwei Deng, Baomin Xu, Xinyan Zhao
Low-melting-point alloys are introduced as innovative electrodes for inverted perovskite solar cells (PSCs) PSCs with In–Sn–Bi electrodes fabricated by doctor printing achieved a record efficiency of 22.48% and exhibited high stability in air.
